0022600007.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (1-0, 2nd in the Northwest, 6th in the West) host the Denver Nuggets, who have not yet played a 2026-27 game, in a matchup that has no games yet this season. The Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, but Denver won their last meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10. Oklahoma City will be without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery), while Denver will be without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and have Spencer Jones (hamstring) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision.
